content.text: In this repository, edit README.md only. Insert a new section immediately before the line '## Approach', with the heading '## Entire (session capture)' and these facts in 6 to 8 short lines of plain English: Entire is enabled in this repo (.entire/settings.json, agent hooks under .claude/ and .codex/). An agent session is only captured when the agent is launched from the repository root or from a git worktree of it. With Codex, approve the hooks once with /hooks. Each teammate needs the CLI in their own clone because git hooks are per clone: curl -fsSL https://entire.io/install.sh | bash, then entire enable. To check: entire status, entire session list, entire checkpoint list, and after a push: git ls-remote origin | grep -i entire. Then run git add README.md and git commit -m 'docs: how Entire captures agent sessions in this repo'. Do not push. Do not touch any other file.

input.description: Check worktree status and list README headings

result.output:
9:## Run
34:## Rule: no session without validation
41:## Approach

1	# Hollerau buyer agent — Tacto Negotiation Arena (EHL Finale 2026)
2	
3	An AI buyer for Hollerau Pumpenwerke that negotiates by e-mail with tacto's supplier bots.
4	Code computes (total cost C, levers in EUR, fair price, verified claims); the LLM argues and writes.
5	
6	Built on the tacto starter kit: `arena_kit/` is the kit, unmodified (MIT). Our code lives in
7	`hollerau/` and `eval/`. The kit's own README is `KIT_README.md`.
8	
9	## Run
10	
11	Requirements: Python 3.12 and [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/).
12	
13	```bash
14	uv sync --all-extras
15	cp .env.example .env        # ARENA_API_KEY, and an LLM key (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or LLM_API_KEY)
16	uv run arena data           # data package (+ the Sunday release once public) -> data/package
17	uv run arena me             # key works, practice quota
18	uv run hollerau play case:P01 -v                      # one practice case with our agent
19	uv run hollerau run --set practice --parallel 8       # all hosted practice cases
20	```
21	
22	Live Final (Sunday 12:00; started before 12:00 from the submitted commit, no human in the loop):
23	
24	```bash
25	uv run hollerau run --set final --parallel 10 2>&1 | tee final.log
26	```
27	
28	Offline plumbing without a key: `uv run arena-sim serve --no-clock`, then
29	`ARENA_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8000 uv run arena register team sim` and
30	`ARENA_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8000 ARENA_API_KEY=<sim key> uv run hollerau play case:S01 --agent naive -v`.
31	
32	Environment variables: see `.env.example` (never commit `.env`).
33	
34	## Rule: no session without validation
35	
36	Practice sessions are limited (200 per team per 24 h). Nothing in this repo opens a session on the hosted
37	arena unless the launch was validated by the team lead: `hollerau`, `lab.experiments` and `lab.send` refuse to
38	run without `HOLLERAU_VALIDATED="<who validated, for what>"`. The local simulator is free.
39	Do not call `uv run arena play|run` directly against arena.tacto.ai: it bypasses this check.
40	
41	## Approach
42	
43	`docs/approach.md` (the short description for the submission) and the team vault design doc.
44

input.new_string:
## Entire (session capture)

- Entire is enabled in this repo (`.entire/settings.json`, agent hooks under `.claude/` and `.codex/`).
- An agent session is only captured when the agent is launched from the repository root or from a git worktree of it.
- With Codex, approve the hooks once with `/hooks`.
- Each teammate needs the CLI in their own clone, because git hooks are per clone: `curl -fsSL https://entire.io/install.sh | bash`, then `entire enable`.
- To check: `entire status`, `entire session list`, `entire checkpoint list`.
- After a push, run `git ls-remote origin | grep -i entire`.

## Approach
